name: Grumpy Cat
look: A cat with cream fur, a brown-gray masked face and blue eyes sits on someone's lap and stares at the camera. Its mouth curves down into a permanent frown, giving it a deeply displeased look.
use: Grumpy, negative one-liners. The top caption sets up something cheerful or ordinary and the bottom caption shoots it down with a deadpan, pessimistic reply, often a flat "No."
examples: You should try something new today
describe: cat with a permanent frown looking annoyed
frowning cat with blue eyes sitting on a lap
angry looking cat with a brown face and white fur
unimpressed kitty with a downturned mouth
fluffy cat that always looks mad
origin: Photos of a cat whose feline dwarfism gave her a permanent frown, first shared on Reddit in 2012.
